label: Screenshot
description: Capture the computer's whole screen, at its full size, so a pixel of the image is a pixel of the screen. It runs when `computer` arrives: in a tool loop, gate it on RouteComputerCall's `screenshot` port through `_should_flow`.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: A sentence a model can read back as the tool's result, naming the screen's size.

outputs.name: image
outputs.description: The screenshot, a PNG stored with the run.

metadataPorts.name: tools
metadataPorts.description: The tools a model calls this node through, in Anthropic's names and in OpenAI's: gather them up to the LLM node's `tools` through metadata ports.

anthropic.description: Take a screenshot of the whole screen. Take one before you act, and after each action or group of actions, then say in one sentence whether it did what you meant before you go on. Every coordinate you give is a pixel of the last full screenshot.
anthropic.name: screenshot

openai.description: Take a screenshot of the whole screen. Take one before you act, and after each action or group of actions, then say in one sentence whether it did what you meant before you go on. Every coordinate you give is a pixel of the last full screenshot.
openai.name: screenshot
